metadata.description: Golden dataset for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of Jenkins chatbot

questions.question: How do I install Jenkins on Ubuntu?
questions.expected_answer: To install Jenkins on Ubuntu: 1) Add the Jenkins repository key: wget -q -O - https://pkg.jenkins.io/debian/jenkins.io.key | sudo apt-key add - 2) Add the repository: sudo sh -c 'echo deb http://pkg.jenkins.io/debian-stable binary/ > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/jenkins.list' 3) Update and install: sudo apt update && sudo apt install jenkins 4) Start Jenkins: sudo systemctl start jenkins
questions.ground_truth_context: Jenkins installation on Ubuntu requires adding the official Jenkins repository and using apt package manager.

questions.question: What is a Jenkins pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: A Jenkins Pipeline is a suite of plugins that supports implementing and integrating continuous delivery pipelines into Jenkins. It provides an extensible set of tools for modeling simple-to-complex delivery pipelines as code via the Pipeline DSL.
questions.ground_truth_context: Pipeline is a Jenkins feature for defining build processes as code.

questions.question: How do I create a Jenkinsfile?
questions.expected_answer: Create a file named 'Jenkinsfile' in your repository root. Use either Declarative syntax (starting with 'pipeline { }') or Scripted syntax (starting with 'node { }'). Define stages, steps, and post actions for your CI/CD workflow.
questions.ground_truth_context: Jenkinsfile defines pipeline as code in repository.

questions.question: What are Jenkins agents?
questions.expected_answer: Jenkins agents (formerly slaves) are machines that execute jobs dispatched by the controller. They can run on different operating systems and configurations, allowing distributed builds and parallel execution.
questions.ground_truth_context: Agents execute builds on behalf of the Jenkins controller.

questions.question: How do I configure Jenkins credentials?
questions.expected_answer: Go to Manage Jenkins > Credentials > System > Global credentials. Click 'Add Credentials' and select the credential type (Username/Password, SSH Key, Secret text, etc.). Provide an ID and description for reference in pipelines.
questions.ground_truth_context: Jenkins credentials are managed through the Credentials plugin.

questions.question: What is the difference between Declarative and Scripted Pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: Declarative Pipeline uses a simplified, opinionated syntax with 'pipeline { }' block and predefined structure. Scripted Pipeline uses Groovy-based syntax with 'node { }' block offering more flexibility but less structure. Declarative is recommended for most use cases.

questions.question: How do I trigger a Jenkins job remotely?
questions.expected_answer: Enable 'Trigger builds remotely' in job configuration and set an authentication token. Then call: curl -X POST JENKINS_URL/job/JOB_NAME/build?token=TOKEN. For authenticated access, include user credentials.
questions.ground_truth_context: Remote triggering uses HTTP API with token authentication.

questions.question: How do I backup Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Backup the JENKINS_HOME directory which contains all configurations, jobs, plugins, and build history. Use the ThinBackup plugin for scheduled backups, or manually copy the directory. Important subdirectories: jobs/, config.xml, users/, secrets/.

questions.question: What are Jenkins shared libraries?
questions.expected_answer: Shared Libraries allow you to define reusable code (Groovy scripts) that can be shared across multiple pipelines. They're stored in a separate Git repository and loaded into pipelines using @Library annotation.
questions.ground_truth_context: Shared libraries enable code reuse across pipelines.

questions.question: How do I set environment variables in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: In Declarative Pipeline, use the 'environment' block: environment { VAR = 'value' }. For global variables, go to Manage Jenkins > Configure System > Global properties > Environment variables. In Scripted, use withEnv(['VAR=value']) { }.
questions.ground_truth_context: Environment variables can be set at multiple levels.

questions.question: How do I archive artifacts in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Use the archiveArtifacts step: archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'target/*.jar', fingerprint: true. In Declarative Pipeline, place this in a post section or within stage steps. Artifacts are stored on the controller and accessible from the build page.

questions.question: What is Jenkins Blue Ocean?
questions.expected_answer: Blue Ocean is a modern UI for Jenkins that provides a visual pipeline editor, improved visualization of pipeline runs, and a more intuitive user experience. It's designed to simplify pipeline creation and monitoring.
questions.ground_truth_context: Blue Ocean modernizes the Jenkins interface.

questions.question: How do I run parallel stages in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Use the 'parallel' directive: parallel { stage('A') { steps { } } stage('B') { steps { } } }. Each parallel branch runs concurrently. You can use failFast: true to abort remaining branches if one fails.

questions.question: How do I approve scripts in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Go to Manage Jenkins > In-process Script Approval. Pending script approvals appear here when sandboxed scripts use unapproved methods. Review each signature carefully before approving to avoid security risks.
questions.ground_truth_context: Script Security plugin requires approval for unsafe operations.

questions.question: What is a Jenkins node?
questions.expected_answer: A node is a machine that is part of the Jenkins environment and capable of executing pipelines or jobs. The built-in node runs on the controller. Additional nodes (agents) can be added for distributed builds.
questions.ground_truth_context: Nodes are execution environments in Jenkins.

questions.question: How do I configure webhooks in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Install the Generic Webhook Trigger plugin or use platform-specific plugins (GitHub, GitLab). Configure the webhook URL in your repository settings pointing to JENKINS_URL/github-webhook/ or /generic-webhook-trigger/invoke.

questions.question: How do I view Jenkins logs?
questions.expected_answer: System logs: Manage Jenkins > System Log. Job console output: Click on build number > Console Output. For controller logs, check /var/log/jenkins/jenkins.log (Linux) or JENKINS_HOME/logs/.
questions.ground_truth_context: Jenkins provides multiple log access points.

questions.question: What is Jenkins Configuration as Code (JCasC)?
questions.expected_answer: JCasC allows you to define Jenkins configuration in YAML files. It automates the configuration of Jenkins controller, plugins, credentials, and jobs. Place jenkins.yaml in JENKINS_HOME or specify via CASC_JENKINS_CONFIG.

questions.question: How do I use parameters in Jenkins pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: Define parameters in the 'parameters' block: parameters { string(name: 'BRANCH', defaultValue: 'main') choice(name: 'ENV', choices: ['dev', 'prod']) }. Access with params.BRANCH in pipeline steps.

questions.question: How do I secure Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Enable security: Manage Jenkins > Configure Global Security. Use matrix-based authorization, enable CSRF protection, use HTTPS, keep plugins updated, restrict script approval, and use credentials plugin for secrets.

questions.question: What is a Jenkins workspace?
questions.expected_answer: The workspace is a directory on the agent where Jenkins checks out source code and runs build steps. Each job has its own workspace. Use cleanWs() step or Workspace Cleanup plugin to manage workspace size.
questions.ground_truth_context: Workspace is the job's working directory.

questions.question: How do I schedule Jenkins jobs?
questions.expected_answer: Use the 'triggers' block with cron syntax: triggers { cron('H 2 * * *') } schedules daily at 2 AM. In freestyle jobs, check 'Build periodically' and enter the cron expression. H adds hash-based jitter.

questions.question: How do I use Docker in Jenkins pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: Use the 'docker' agent or docker step: agent { docker { image 'maven:3.8' } }. For more control, use docker.image('name').inside { } in Scripted Pipeline. Requires Docker Pipeline plugin.

questions.question: What are Jenkins post actions?
questions.expected_answer: Post actions run after pipeline stages complete. Conditions include: always, success, failure, unstable, changed, aborted. Define in post { } block: post { always { cleanWs() } failure { emailext(...) } }.
questions.ground_truth_context: Post section handles pipeline completion actions.

questions.question: How do I use input step in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Use the input step to pause and wait for user approval: input message: 'Deploy to production?', ok: 'Deploy'. Add parameters for additional input. Use timeout to prevent indefinite waits.
questions.ground_truth_context: Input step enables manual approval gates.

questions.question: How do I configure Jenkins executors?
questions.expected_answer: Go to Manage Jenkins > Nodes > Built-In Node > Configure. Set 'Number of executors' based on available CPU cores. Each executor handles one concurrent build. For agents, configure during node creation.

questions.question: What is Jenkins multibranch pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: Multibranch Pipeline automatically creates jobs for each branch in a repository that contains a Jenkinsfile. It discovers branches, creates/deletes jobs automatically, and provides branch-specific builds.

questions.question: How do I use stash and unstash in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: stash saves files for use in another stage/node: stash name: 'source', includes: 'src/**'. unstash retrieves them: unstash 'source'. Useful for sharing files across nodes or stages.
questions.ground_truth_context: Stash enables file sharing across pipeline.

questions.question: How do I restart Jenkins safely?
questions.expected_answer: Use 'Prepare for Shutdown' in Manage Jenkins to stop new builds. Wait for running builds to complete. Then access JENKINS_URL/safeRestart or use command line: sudo systemctl restart jenkins.
questions.ground_truth_context: Safe restart avoids interrupting running builds.

questions.question: What are Jenkins build tools?
questions.expected_answer: Jenkins integrates with build tools like Maven, Gradle, Ant, npm, and Make. Configure in Global Tool Configuration to auto-install versions. Use tools {} block in pipeline to specify required tools.
questions.ground_truth_context: Build tools are configured globally in Jenkins.

questions.question: How do I install Jenkins plugins?
questions.expected_answer: Go to Manage Jenkins > Plugins > Available plugins. Search for the plugin, select it, and click 'Install'. Alternatively, use Jenkins CLI: java -jar jenkins-cli.jar install-plugin PLUGIN_NAME.

questions.question: What is the Git plugin for Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: The Git plugin enables Jenkins to clone Git repositories, track branches, and trigger builds on commits. Configure repository URL and credentials in job settings or use git step in pipeline.
questions.ground_truth_context: Git plugin is essential for Git-based projects.

questions.question: How do I use the GitHub plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Install GitHub plugin, configure GitHub server in system settings with Personal Access Token. In jobs, select 'GitHub project' and configure webhook for automatic triggering on push/PR events.
questions.ground_truth_context: GitHub plugin integrates Jenkins with GitHub.

questions.question: What is the Slack Notification plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Slack Notification plugin sends build notifications to Slack channels. Configure workspace and token in system settings. Use slackSend step: slackSend channel: '#builds', message: 'Build ${currentBuild.result}'.

questions.question: How do I configure the Email Extension plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Configure SMTP server in Manage Jenkins > System. Use emailext step: emailext subject: 'Build ${BUILD_STATUS}', body: '${BUILD_LOG}', to: 'team@example.com'. Supports triggers for different build outcomes.
questions.ground_truth_context: Email Extension provides advanced email notifications.

questions.question: What is the Pipeline plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Pipeline plugin (workflow-aggregator) is the core plugin that enables Pipeline as Code in Jenkins. It includes Pipeline: Groovy, Pipeline: Declarative, Blue Ocean, and other pipeline-related plugins.
questions.ground_truth_context: Pipeline plugin is fundamental for modern Jenkins.

questions.question: How do I use the Credentials plugin?
questions.expected_answer: The Credentials plugin manages sensitive data. Access via Manage Jenkins > Credentials. Use withCredentials step in pipeline: withCredentials([usernamePassword(credentialsId: 'myId', usernameVariable: 'USER', passwordVariable: 'PASS')]) { }.

questions.question: What is the Docker plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Docker plugin enables dynamic agent provisioning using Docker containers. Configure Docker cloud in Manage Jenkins > Clouds. Agents are created on-demand for builds and destroyed after completion.

questions.question: How do I use the JUnit plugin?
questions.expected_answer: JUnit plugin parses test results in JUnit XML format. Use junit step: junit 'target/surefire-reports/*.xml'. Results appear in build page with trends, test history, and failure details.

questions.question: What is the Role-based Authorization Strategy plugin?
questions.expected_answer: This plugin provides role-based access control. Create global roles, project roles, and agent roles. Assign roles to users/groups. More granular than matrix-based security.
questions.ground_truth_context: Role Strategy enables fine-grained access control.

questions.question: How do I use the Artifactory plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Configure Artifactory server in system settings. Use rtUpload and rtDownload steps. In Declarative: rtServer(id: 'ARTIFACTORY_SERVER', url: '...'). Supports Maven, Gradle, npm integration.

questions.question: What is the SonarQube plugin?
questions.expected_answer: SonarQube plugin integrates code quality analysis. Configure SonarQube server in system settings. Use withSonarQubeEnv wrapper and sh 'mvn sonar:sonar'. Quality gate status affects build result.
questions.ground_truth_context: SonarQube plugin enables code quality gates.

questions.question: How do I use the Kubernetes plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Kubernetes plugin provisions agents as pods. Configure Kubernetes cloud with cluster credentials. Define pod templates with containers. Agents scale dynamically based on build queue.

questions.question: What is the Build Timeout plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Build Timeout plugin aborts builds exceeding time limits. In pipeline: timeout(time: 30, unit: 'MINUTES') { }. Options include absolute timeout, deadline, and likelihood-based timeout.

questions.question: How do I use the Throttle Concurrent Builds plugin?
questions.expected_answer: This plugin limits concurrent builds. Define categories with max concurrent builds. Apply to jobs via 'Throttle Concurrent Builds' checkbox. Use throttle step in pipeline.

questions.question: What is the Matrix Authorization plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Matrix Authorization provides permission matrix for users/groups. Configure in Configure Global Security. Grant specific permissions (read, build, configure) per user or group for granular access control.

questions.question: How do I configure the SSH plugin?
questions.expected_answer: SSH plugin executes commands on remote hosts. Add SSH credentials (private key). Use sshCommand step: sshCommand remote: [name: 'server', host: 'host.com', user: 'admin'], command: 'deploy.sh'.
questions.ground_truth_context: SSH plugin enables remote command execution.

questions.question: What is the LDAP plugin?
questions.expected_answer: LDAP plugin enables authentication against LDAP/Active Directory. Configure server URL, bind DN, and user search base in Security Realm settings. Supports group-based authorization.

questions.question: How do I use the Workspace Cleanup plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Workspace Cleanup plugin deletes workspace before/after builds. Use cleanWs() step in pipeline. Configure patterns to include/exclude specific files. Helps manage disk space.

questions.question: What is the Git Parameter plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Git Parameter plugin provides branch/tag/revision selection as build parameter. Add Git Parameter in job configuration. Users select branch when triggering builds. Supports filtering and sorting.

questions.question: How do I use the Publish Over SSH plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Configure SSH servers in system settings with host, credentials, and remote directory. In jobs, add 'Send build artifacts over SSH' post-build action. Specify source files and commands.
questions.ground_truth_context: Publish Over SSH deploys artifacts remotely.

questions.question: What is the AnsiColor plugin?
questions.expected_answer: AnsiColor plugin renders ANSI color codes in console output. Wrap steps with ansiColor: ansiColor('xterm') { sh 'colorful-script.sh' }. Improves readability of colored output.

questions.question: How do I use the Copy Artifact plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Copy Artifact plugin copies artifacts between jobs. Use copyArtifacts step: copyArtifacts projectName: 'upstream', filter: '*.jar', target: 'libs/'. Select which build to copy from.
questions.ground_truth_context: Copy Artifact shares files between jobs.

questions.question: What is the Pipeline Utility Steps plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Pipeline Utility Steps provides file manipulation steps: readJSON, writeJSON, readYaml, writeYaml, readProperties, zip, unzip, findFiles. Essential for configuration management in pipelines.

questions.question: How do I configure the Active Choices plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Active Choices plugin creates dynamic parameters with Groovy scripts. Add Active Choices Parameter, write Groovy returning list of choices. Can reference other parameters for cascading selection.

questions.question: What is the Build Name Setter plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Build Name Setter customizes build display names. Use buildName step: buildName 'v${VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}'. Makes build history more informative and searchable.
questions.ground_truth_context: Build Name Setter improves build identification.

questions.question: How do I use the Lockable Resources plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Lockable Resources plugin manages shared resources. Define resources in system settings. Use lock step: lock(resource: 'deployment-server') { }. Prevents concurrent access to limited resources.

questions.question: What is the Job DSL plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Job DSL plugin creates jobs programmatically using Groovy DSL. Write seed jobs that generate other jobs. Enables infrastructure-as-code for Jenkins job configuration.

questions.question: How do I use the Timestamper plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Timestamper plugin adds timestamps to console output. Enable in job configuration or use timestamps step: timestamps { sh 'long-running-script.sh' }. Helps debug timing issues.
questions.ground_truth_context: Timestamper adds time context to logs.

questions.question: What is the HTTP Request plugin?
questions.expected_answer: HTTP Request plugin makes HTTP calls from pipeline. Use httpRequest step: httpRequest url: 'https://api.example.com', httpMode: 'POST', contentType: 'APPLICATION_JSON', requestBody: '{}'.

questions.question: How do I configure GitLab integration?
questions.expected_answer: Install GitLab plugin, configure GitLab connection in system settings. Add webhook in GitLab pointing to Jenkins. Use gitlabCommitStatus step to report build status back to GitLab.
questions.ground_truth_context: GitLab plugin integrates Jenkins with GitLab.

questions.question: What is the Configuration as Code plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Configuration as Code (JCasC) plugin exports/imports Jenkins configuration as YAML. Place jenkins.yaml in JENKINS_HOME. Enables reproducible Jenkins setup and version-controlled configuration.

questions.question: How do I use the Blue Ocean plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Install Blue Ocean from plugin manager. Access via 'Open Blue Ocean' link. Use visual pipeline editor to create Jenkinsfiles. View pipeline runs with improved visualization.

questions.question: What is the Warnings Next Generation plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Warnings NG plugin analyzes static analysis reports. Use recordIssues step: recordIssues tools: [checkStyle(), spotBugs()]. Aggregates warnings from multiple tools with trend visualization.

questions.question: How do I configure AWS integration?
questions.expected_answer: Install AWS plugins (EC2, CodeBuild, S3). Configure AWS credentials in credentials store. Use withAWS wrapper: withAWS(credentials: 'aws-creds', region: 'us-east-1') { s3Upload(...) }.

questions.question: What is the Pipeline Graph View plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Pipeline Graph View provides graphical representation of pipeline stages. Shows stage duration, parallel branches, and success/failure status. Accessible from build page sidebar.

questions.question: How do I use the Parameterized Trigger plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Parameterized Trigger invokes downstream jobs with parameters. Use build step: build job: 'downstream', parameters: [string(name: 'VERSION', value: '1.0')]. Enables pipeline orchestration.

questions.question: What is the Dashboard View plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Dashboard View creates customizable dashboards showing job status, build trends, and statistics. Add portlets like build statistics, job status, test trends. Useful for team visibility.

questions.question: How do I configure Azure integration?
questions.expected_answer: Install Azure plugins (VM Agents, Storage, AD). Configure Azure credentials with service principal. Use azureUpload for blob storage: azureUpload storageCredentialId: 'azure', containerName: 'builds'.

questions.question: What is the Mask Passwords plugin?
questions.expected_answer: Mask Passwords plugin hides sensitive values in console output. Configure global password parameters. Use wrap([$class: 'MaskPasswordsBuildWrapper']) { } or maskPasswords step in pipeline.
questions.ground_truth_context: Mask Passwords protects secrets in logs.

questions.question: How do I fix 'java.lang.OutOfMemoryError' in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Increase heap memory: edit JAVA_OPTS in jenkins startup config, add '-Xmx4g -Xms2g'. Monitor with Monitoring plugin. Check for memory leaks, reduce build history, prune old builds.

questions.question: Why is my Jenkins build stuck in queue?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Available executors on matching agents, 2) Agent online status, 3) Label matching, 4) Resource locks, 5) Throttle configurations. View queue reason by hovering over queued build.
questions.ground_truth_context: Queue issues relate to executor availability.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Permission denied' when cloning Git repository?
questions.expected_answer: Verify: 1) Credentials are configured correctly in Jenkins, 2) SSH key has correct permissions (chmod 600), 3) Repository access rights for Jenkins user, 4) Known hosts configured for SSH.
questions.ground_truth_context: Git clone failures often relate to credentials.

questions.question: Why does my pipeline fail with 'Scripts not permitted to use method'?
questions.expected_answer: The script uses unapproved methods. Go to Manage Jenkins > In-process Script Approval to approve pending signatures. Consider using approved alternatives or moving logic to shared library.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Disk space is too low' error?
questions.expected_answer: 1) Clean old builds: Manage Old Data, 2) Configure build rotation in jobs, 3) Use Disk Usage plugin to find large workspaces, 4) Clean workspaces with cleanWs(), 5) Move JENKINS_HOME to larger disk.

questions.question: Why is my agent showing as offline?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Network connectivity to controller, 2) Agent process running on node, 3) JNLP port access (if using JNLP agent), 4) Jenkins URL configuration, 5) Agent logs for connection errors.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Unable to create pipeline: No such DSL method' error?
questions.expected_answer: Install required plugin providing the step. Check: 1) Plugin is installed and enabled, 2) Correct step syntax, 3) Jenkins restart after plugin install. Popular missing: Pipeline: GitHub steps.
questions.ground_truth_context: DSL method errors indicate missing plugins.

questions.question: Why does my build fail with 'Timeout' error?
questions.expected_answer: Build exceeded configured timeout. Increase timeout: timeout(time: 60, unit: 'MINUTES') { }. Check for: 1) Hung processes, 2) Network delays, 3) Resource contention, 4) Infinite loops.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Cannot run program' error in pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: The executable is not found. Check: 1) Tool is installed on agent, 2) PATH includes tool directory, 3) Use tool step to configure: tools { maven 'Maven-3.8' }. 4) Full path to executable.
questions.ground_truth_context: Program errors relate to PATH configuration.

questions.question: Why does my Jenkinsfile fail with 'WorkflowScript: N: unexpected token'?
questions.expected_answer: Syntax error in Jenkinsfile. Common causes: 1) Missing closing braces, 2) Incorrect string quotes, 3) Invalid Groovy syntax, 4) Using scripted syntax in declarative blocks. Use Pipeline Syntax helper.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Failed to connect to repository' error?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Repository URL is correct, 2) Credentials have read access, 3) Network/firewall allows connection, 4) Git plugin installed, 5) SSL certificates if using HTTPS.

questions.question: Why does Jenkins show 'No valid crumb' error?
questions.expected_answer: CSRF protection is blocking the request. Include Jenkins-Crumb header in API calls. Get crumb from: JENKINS_URL/crumbIssuer/api/json. Disable only for trusted environments.
questions.ground_truth_context: Crumb errors relate to CSRF protection.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Plugin failed to start' error?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Plugin compatibility with Jenkins version, 2) Required dependencies installed, 3) Java version compatibility. Try: 1) Update plugin, 2) Reinstall, 3) Check logs for specific error.

questions.question: Why does my Docker build fail with 'permission denied' for docker.sock?
questions.expected_answer: Jenkins user lacks Docker socket access. Solutions: 1) Add jenkins user to docker group, 2) Set socket permissions, 3) Use Docker-in-Docker, 4) Use rootless Docker. Restart agent after changes.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Cannot lock checkout' error?
questions.expected_answer: Workspace is locked by another process. Solutions: 1) Enable concurrent builds if appropriate, 2) Use custom workspace per build, 3) Check for orphaned processes, 4) Delete workspace lock file.

questions.question: Why does my parallel stage fail with 'Required context class hudson.FilePath is missing'?
questions.expected_answer: Parallel stages need explicit node allocation. Add 'node' block inside each parallel branch when not using declarative agent, or specify agent for each stage.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Unable to find valid certification path' SSL error?
questions.expected_answer: Add certificate to Java truststore: keytool -import -trustcacerts -keystore $JAVA_HOME/lib/security/cacerts -file cert.pem. Or disable verification (not recommended): -Djavax.net.ssl.trustAll=true.

questions.question: Why does my pipeline fail with 'CredentialNotFoundException'?
questions.expected_answer: Credentials ID not found. Check: 1) Credential exists in Jenkins, 2) Correct ID used in pipeline, 3) Credential scope allows access, 4) Domain restrictions if using domains.
questions.ground_truth_context: Credential errors relate to ID or scope.

questions.question: How do I fix 'FATAL: command execution failed' error?
questions.expected_answer: The command returned non-zero exit code. Check: 1) Command output for details, 2) Prerequisites met, 3) Environment variables set, 4) Working directory correct. Use returnStatus: true to handle.

questions.question: Why does my multibranch pipeline not discover branches?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Jenkinsfile exists in branches, 2) Scan credentials configured, 3) Branch inclusion pattern, 4) Repository is accessible. Click 'Scan Multibranch Pipeline Now' and check scan log.

questions.question: How do I fix 'java.io.NotSerializableException' in pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: Pipeline state must be serializable at CPS suspension points. Use @NonCPS annotation for methods that shouldn't suspend. Avoid storing non-serializable objects in variables across steps.

questions.question: Why does my webhook not trigger builds?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Webhook URL correct (include trailing slash if needed), 2) Jenkins accessible from source system, 3) Correct event types selected, 4) Job configured to trigger on webhook, 5) Check webhook delivery logs.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Build step failed with exception' without details?
questions.expected_answer: Enable verbose logging: 1) Add -verbose flag to commands, 2) Enable timestamps plugin, 3) Check system logs for stack traces, 4) Use try-catch with catchError step to capture details.

questions.question: Why does my Kubernetes agent pod fail to start?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Pod template configuration, 2) Service account permissions, 3) Resource limits, 4) Image pull secrets, 5) Node capacity. Use kubectl describe pod to see events.
questions.ground_truth_context: K8s agent failures appear in pod events.

questions.question: How do I fix 'Blocking/Unblocking requires a node context'?
questions.expected_answer: File operations require node context. Wrap file operations with node { } block or ensure running on an agent. Declarative: ensure agent is not 'none' for stages using files.

questions.question: Why do my tests show 0 results in Jenkins?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Test report path pattern matches actual files, 2) Tests actually produce report files, 3) Report format matches plugin (JUnit XML), 4) Report directory not cleaned before publishing.
questions.ground_truth_context: Test results need correct path patterns.

questions.question: How do I fix 'IllegalArgumentException: No enum constant' error?
questions.expected_answer: Parameter value doesn't match expected enum options. Check: 1) Parameter value matches case exactly, 2) Choice parameter options, 3) String trimming for whitespace. Use try-catch for validation.

questions.question: Why is my Jenkins very slow?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Heap memory allocation, 2) Number of executors vs resources, 3) Build history retention, 4) Plugin count and updates, 5) Disk I/O (SSD recommended), 6) Too many jobs polling SCM.

questions.question: How do I fix 'RejectedAccessException' in pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: Script uses blocked method in sandbox. Go to Manage Jenkins > In-process Script Approval. Approve the method signature or refactor to use allowlisted alternatives.

questions.question: Why does my SCM poll not trigger builds?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Poll SCM schedule syntax, 2) Changes actually in repository, 3) Correct branch configured, 4) Enable SCM poll log for diagnostics: Manage Jenkins > System Log > Add 'hudson.triggers.SCMTrigger'.

questions.question: How do I fix 'No space left on device' during build?
questions.expected_answer: Workspace disk full. Solutions: 1) Add cleanWs() in post steps, 2) Configure workspace cleanup, 3) Reduce artifact retention, 4) Use external artifact storage, 5) Mount larger disk for workspaces.

questions.question: Why does my Jenkins pipeline hang indefinitely?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) Input steps waiting for approval, 2) Processes waiting for input, 3) Locks waiting for release, 4) Network operations timing out. Use timeout step to prevent indefinite hangs.

questions.question: How do I fix 'No such property' error in Jenkinsfile?
questions.expected_answer: Variable not defined in scope. Check: 1) Variable declaration, 2) Script block inside declarative, 3) Environment variable access (use env.VAR), 4) Parameter access (use params.PARAM).

questions.question: Why does my artifact upload fail silently?
questions.expected_answer: Check: 1) archiveArtifacts path pattern, 2) Files exist at archive time, 3) File permissions, 4) Disk space on controller. Use 'fingerprint: true' option for tracking. Check build log for warnings.
questions.ground_truth_context: Archive requires correct paths and files.

questions.question: How do I debug pipeline script errors?
questions.expected_answer: 1) Use 'Replay' to modify and rerun, 2) Add echo statements for debugging, 3) Use try-catch with catchError, 4) Enable pipeline debug logs via JENKINS_URL/pipeline-syntax/globals, 5) Use Blue Ocean for visualization.
questions.ground_truth_context: Pipeline debugging uses replay and logging.
